pyproject.toml:
[project]
description = "High-velocity CLI application."
readme = "README.md"
authors = [{ name = "Demo Author", email = "your-email" }]
license = { file = "LICENSE" }
classifiers = [
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
]
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "A",   # flake8-builtins
    "B",   # flake8-bugbear
    "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions
    "E",   # pycodestyle errors
    "F",   # Pyflakes
    "I",   # isort
    "RUF", # Ruff-specific
    "UP",  # pyupgrade
]
ignore = [
    "E501", # Line too long - handled automatically by `ruff format`
]

pre_commit_local_hooks:
- id: ruff-check
        name: ruff check
        entry: uv run ruff check --fix
        language: system
        types: [python]
        require_serial: true

      - id: ruff-format
        name: ruff format
        entry: uv run ruff format
        language: system
        types: [python]
        require_serial: true
ci_steps:
- name: Run Ruff Linter
        if: matrix.os == '<% PRIMARY_OS %>' && matrix.python-version == '<% BASELINE_PYTHON %>'
        run: uv run ruff check --output-format=github .

      - name: Run Ruff Formatter
        if: matrix.os == '<% PRIMARY_OS %>' && matrix.python-version == '<% BASELINE_PYTHON %>'
        run: uv run ruff format --check --output-format=github .
